repositories.name: synth-cache
repositories.description: High-throughput distributed in-memory cache written in Go with Raft consensus, LRU eviction, and automatic replica gossip.
repositories.readme:
# synth-cache

> High-throughput distributed in-memory cache engine written in Go.

`synth-cache` implements the Raft consensus algorithm for distributed multi-node consensus, consistent hash ring topology, and zero-allocation socket serialization.

## Key Architectural Features
- **Raft Consensus**: Leader election, log replication, and cluster membership reconfiguration.
- **Zero-Allocation Deserialization**: Binary protocol parser using memory pools (`sync.Pool`).
- **LRU & LFU Adaptive Eviction**: Memory-bounded cache tiers with background slab defragmentation.
- **Sub-Millisecond p99**: Benchmarked at 180,000 queries per second per node under 800µs latency.

## Quick Start
```bash
# Pull binary and start master node
go install github.com/alexrivera-dev/synth-cache@latest
synth-cache start --cluster-id=node-1 --port=7070
```

## Benchmark Comparison
| System | Read Throughput (ops/s) | p99 Latency |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Redis Single | 110,000 | 1.2ms |
| synth-cache Go Engine | 184,000 | 0.78ms |

repositories.name: retro-term-react
repositories.description: A zero-dependency React & Next.js terminal emulator component featuring command history, tab autocomplete, scanlines, and VT100 escapes.
repositories.readme:
# retro-term-react

> Tactile retro terminal interface component for modern React and Next.js applications.

## Highlights
- **Custom Command Dispatcher**: Built-in async command registration with promise resolution.
- **VT100 & ANSI Color Support**: Parse and render ANSI 16-color and 256-color escape sequences.
- **History Navigation & Tab Completion**: Authentic Unix-like arrow key recall and fuzzy auto-completion.
- **CRT Visual Filters**: Optional hardware-accelerated CRT curvature, scanlines, and phosphorescent bloom.

## Installation
```bash
npm install retro-term-react
```

repositories.name: stream-craft
repositories.description: Real-time reactive analytics streaming pipeline with WebSockets, Kafka connector, and live canvas dashboard visualization.
repositories.readme:
# stream-craft

Real-time distributed data aggregation engine and live canvas dashboard.

### Pipeline Overview
1. Ingest telemetry events through HTTP/gRPC ingress gateway.
2. Partition and route into Apache Kafka event log.
3. Aggregate sliding-window metrics using Node.js stream transformers.
4. Broadcast binary delta updates to client browser dashboards via WebSockets.

repositories.name: pulse-kv
repositories.description: Persistent Log-Structured Merge (LSM) key-value storage engine engineered in Go with SSTable compaction and Bloom filters.
repositories.readme:
# pulse-kv

An educational and battle-tested LSM-tree key-value store built in Golang.

### Architecture
- MemTable backed by concurrent SkipList.
- Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) for instant crash recovery.
- Leveled SSTable compaction to reduce read amplification.
- Probabilistic Bloom filters to eliminate unnecessary disk seeks.
